import asyncio
from sqlalchemy import select
from app.services.database import AsyncSessionLocal
from app.models.token import Token
from app.enums import TokenStatus

async def check_token\(\):
    async with AsyncSessionLocal\(\) as db:
        db.expire_all\(\)
        result = await db.execute\(select\(Token\).filter\(Token.token == ''GUYWFz-dNAblpppqptxwWNgIPp8xYekgzVqGGU4FatE''\)\)
        token = result.scalar_one_or_none\(\)
        if token:
            await db.refresh\(token\)
            print\(f''Token found: id={token.id}, status={repr\(token.status\)}''\)
            print\(f''ACTIVE value: {repr\(TokenStatus.ACTIVE.value\)}''\)
            print\(f''Is NOT active: {token.status != TokenStatus.ACTIVE.value}''\)
            print\(f''Is SUSPENDED: {token.status == TokenStatus.SUSPENDED.value}''\)
        else:
            print\(''Token not found''\)

asyncio.run\(check_token\(\)\)
")
